items.description: An outsider can extend a growable venue without a stored ELF fingerprint, then block new opens until Emergency revalidation.

1.evidence: Accounts first: FlagVenueUpgraded:50-67 requires the canonical AccountLoader VenueGuard PDA/version, a venue index below VENUE_PROGRAMS, the compiled ProgramData key and loader owner; read_deploy_slot also requires its ProgramData header. Both require matching writable Program/ProgramData, loader ownership, a positive permitted increase, an upgradeable authority field, a later slot and rent funding; an outsider can supply these without the upgrade authority signature. Both resize, redeploy the unchanged ELF and store clock_slot. With guard_slot[4]=100, upgraded=0, guard_len[2]=0 and a successful extension in slot 101, flag_venue_upgraded:128 passes and :130-135 skips is_upgrade because VenueGuard::elf_fingerprint:110-114 returns None; :136 sets bit 4. Ordinary init/revalidation and downstream guards are traced below, not bypassed.

2.evidence: Source-reachable but deployment-conditional: InitializeConfig requires the real short.win upgrade-authority signer and new canonical accounts; an honest init writes upgraded=0 and guard_slot at :156-160 while leaving all fingerprint lengths zero. The enabled-venue bitmask permits CPMM. RevalidateVenue requires the configured pause-authority signer, canonical config/guard and authentic ProgramData; at the current expected_slot it accepts expected_elf_hash=[0;32], clears the fingerprint and clears the latch (:72-108). Neither path requires malicious governance. The outsider extension additionally requires a still-upgradeable account below the 10 MiB cap and a compatible active loader. Use 10,240 bytes when available, or the permitted smaller final increase to the cap. Immutable/full-sized accounts block this path; source-described capped Pump/PumpSwap accounts are excluded. No live fingerprint, size, authority or feature-state query was performed; source comments identifying growable venues are not live deployment validation.

3.evidence: The outsider pays any extension rent shortfall and transaction fees, then sends flag_venue_upgraded with authentic accounts. The matching account/address and payer signature requirements do not require the venue upgrade signer or the short.win Emergency signer. Honest init creates the condition directly, so this is an unprivileged amplifier of an ordinary initialization state, not harm caused solely by a malicious admin.
